title: Partier
tagline: Partier is a decentralized mobile instagram-like social network that aims to bring together in the same platform parties, social gatherings and meetings of crypto events where you can generate an NFT ticket to your side-event and people can buy it with their crypto wallets.

prizes.placement: 🗃 Coinbase — 🥈 Best Integration of Coinbase Wallet
prizes.title: Coinbase Cloud

description:
One of the main issues of being a beginner in the Crypto environment is based on the fact that most side-events, gatherings, and parties don’t have a single and simple platform to find these events to network with other people related to Web3 and have to use platforms that can generate some sort of challenge to find such events. 
So, our solution is to create a simple, yet effective, decentralized instagram-like social network that aims to bring the same mobile application using Polygon blockchain for availability and low price on transactions. 
This dApp exposes all the side-events of a specific conferences in a same timeline with pictures stored in the IPFS Web3.storage and it generates the tickets of such gatherings as NFT’s that are stored in IPFS NFT.storage. Those tickets are untransferable to guarantee that there are no scalpers/botters. 
Now, event organizers can use a decentralized way to advertise and sell tickets to their events.
